reviews.text:
City Dog has the kindest groomers in the business. I have been to a lot of other places over the years and none of the staff know how to gently calm my anxious dogs down quite like them. They are so patient and sweet.

I don't even live downtown any more and it is worth it to fight the parking challenges and plan around Padres games to keep taking my dogs there.
Alicia is great! We always get so many compliments about how good Benji looks.

First time here and our groomer, Alicia, did an amazing job with my 10 month old Giant Schnauzer. Despite my puppy being highly anxious and wiggly, she still managed to give her a beautiful asian fusion style cut as requested! Thank you Alicia!

Soooo grateful I gave city dogs a try! I’ve been twice now. They are so friendly and really take the time to ask questions about your pup and what your goals are for their treatment. My dog had to get stitches at the last groomer so I was nervous about finding a new place, and him getting feisty, but he was sooo happy with no issues. He saw Saul the last time and looked as perfect as can be! Also the fairest prices I’ve experienced. I usually go in mornings while I’m at the gym and easy to find parking for close by.

OH MY OH MY city dog is my new favorite place .they are amazing they have selection and fantastic service and prices. We found freeze dried rabbit .they have walk in dog nail trim . A gem hiding in the heart of downtown san diego. Close to petco park and easy to get to. The park street trolley station.  We are so happy we found city dog.thank you.

Stay away from this place!!! They have never dealt with Puli breed obviously, they wanned to treat my Dog as a Doodle or Poodle and were extremelly rude on the phone interupting me while i was trying to explain that i just want her belly and neck shaved. No they insisted to cut my dog short, her beautiful fur ….. and kept beeing rude.. i told them its Puli there is no way to prevent matting completelly its the breed by itself that is cording naturally no matter how hard you brush her everyday.She responded to that ‘well call the coording’. I was shocked by rudnes i askeed what do you mean by call the cording?! Like hello just do what im asking you to do its my dog!! No she wants to be decision maker so i just hanged up after continuous interuptions on phone and disagreements. Maybe they should learn that not every breed with long coat is doodle!!!!!

I never write reviews, but I've had dogs for the past ten years and City Dog Grooming has by far been the best groomers I have ever been to. They take such good care of my dog, he always looks exactly what I expected, and my groomer loves my dog! BIG PLUS. Couldn't recommend this place enough. Brooks loves it here!

City dog is the best groomer of them all. My dog has long hair he's half chow half German Shepard and Everytime he comes home from city dog he looks like a million bucks for a couple months. The older gentleman does my dogs haircut by hand (super impressive) and it's worth every penny. All other groomers have ceased to amaze me until City Dog. I promise you will not be disappointed 💯

Great store. Super friendly staff.

They always treat my dog Ricky Bobby w love and lots of treats.

Update (June 2026):

The owner pressured me to take down my honest review. I'm putting it back now and updating it to reflect my real experience.

I first posted the 3-star review below after a bad experience I had here. The owner asked me to take it down and replace it with a positive one. He repeatedly brought up how hard his employees work and how much the review affected them, and after a lot of pressure I gave in and changed it. I regret that, it didn’t reflect my real experience, and I don't think a business should pressure and guilt a customer into rewriting it.

I'm updating it now because of what happened next. I had a grooming appointment coming up and needed to reschedule. The owner called and told me I needed to keep up my regular frequency, warning that my dog would "mat again" if I didn't. When I explained that her coat is already very short after being shaved last time, and that the matting had been minor, he dismissed all of it. The tone kept getting more commanding, and at one point he said, word for word, "I want you to come in for your appointment tomorrow" — the way you'd speak to a child or an employee. When I brought up my last experience and the fact that he'd pressured me over my review, he told me to forget about it. I said I wouldn't be coming back, and he said ok and hung up. Both times, instead of fixing the problem, City Dog was focused on managing reviews and customer behavior. Apparently that's their business model.

I'm leaving my original review below exactly as I wrote it, including the part where I thanked the owner for apologizing. After everything since, I no longer feel that way. Three years as a loyal customer, and this is how it ended.

Original Review:

I've been a regular at City Dog for almost three years and never had a problem with anyone here, which is why today's experience upset me enough to leave a review.

From the moment I started talking to the groomer Alicia, her attitude was dismissive and disrespectful. My poodle had some matting, and Alicia said she'd need to be "completely shaved" but wouldn't explain what that meant in coat length, wouldn't make eye contact, and was visibly impatient. When I said I was fine with a very short shave but wanted a thin coat left for warmth, she refused. When I asked to keep just a little on the head, she refused that too — no other options. She questioned whether I even brushed my dogs, and told me to take them home and brush them out myself, or she'd hand me a comb to do it on the spot. All within the first few minutes. It felt less like a groomer talking to a client and more like I was being scolded for showing up.

Eventually another groomer stepped in and showed me the length board. The moment I saw the actual length, I said it was fine — thirty seconds, that's all it would have taken if Alicia had been willing to communicate. Instead she said she was "not comfortable working with my dogs" and walked away. I left with both dogs untreated.

In almost three years I never once complained, even when things weren't perfect — times my poodle came home not fully dried and matted, or with small clipper cuts. I handled those at home and said nothing, because I know grooming is hard and small things happen. So being treated this way, when I came in calm and willing to compromise, felt truly shocking.

The owner did apologize and rebook me with a different groomer, which I appreciated. He mentioned Alicia may have been treated poorly by difficult clients recently. I have some sympathy for that — but if a groomer shows up braced for conflict and projects it onto every new client, that's her problem to manage, not something a paying customer should absorb. I came in calmly, asked reasonable questions, and was made to feel like I'd done something wrong just by being there.

Three stars because the rest of the staff have been good to me over the years. I won't be working with Alicia again, and I hope there can be better communication and basic respect in situations like this.

My boy has been butchered so many times, so I was anxious to try a new spot but heard good things about City Dog. Easily the best hair cut he’s ever had! She did such an amazing job, I couldn’t be happier! Their prices are much more reasonable than other places too. If you have a doodle go to City Dog!!

I chose City Dog Grooming after seeing it highly rated above Petco and PetSmart, and I'm very glad I did.
I brought in my little pug, who has some special health concerns, past ear infections and dry eyes, so I'm always cautious about grooming. The staff took the time to listen and made sure detailed notes were passed along to the groomer, which immediately put me at ease.
Maritza did a stellar job. My pug came back clean, smelling great, and his nails were trimmed perfectly. Most importantly, he was calm and well cared for, which tells me everything I need to know.
You can tell this place values a personal touch and pays attention to the details that matter.
Thank you to the entire City Dog team. We'll definitely be back.
Friendly and helpful staff, skilled groomers!
I've been taking both my dog and cat there for years. For grooming  services and products. We love their team!

My family has had dog salons in Texas for 20 years. I am a subject matter expert when it comes to grooming. This place is awful. Choppy job. My dog left with a razor burn and uneven haircut. They banned him without any explanation or notice.
The staff is so friendly, my great dane won’t let me walk by without going in!

I would never recommend this horrible place. My dog ​​went there for the first time because a friend recommended it, and to my shock, they told me they'd only trimmed a tiny bit of his nail. To my horror, they ripped the nail off, and with the audacity to do it myself, they gave me a bandage and some powder. I'm going to demand that they retrain the staff who supposedly have experience and licenses. This is outrageous, and they left him in a terrible state, shaving him too short. And without any shame, they still charged me! This is disgusting. My dog ​​can't even walk properly with his paw. 🤬🤬🤬🤬

We’ve been going to City Dog for years and truly can’t say enough good things about them. They have always treated our dog with such care, and the service is consistently quick, friendly, and professional.

I wanted to share a recent experience that really reinforced why we love this place so much. Our groomer called the day before to let us know she wasn’t feeling well and needed to reschedule. While it was a little tricky for us, we completely understood and appreciated the communication. When we brought our dog in the next day, my husband mentioned wanting to be sure she wasn’t contagious, since we have a 15-month-old at home and it’s the holiday season. They kindly reassured us it was allergies — which we know must be especially tough when working as a groomer — and we felt very comfortable moving forward.

We also asked if a discount might be possible due to the short-notice reschedule, and as always, they were incredibly kind and said they’d check with the owner. Shortly after, they called to let us know they would be discounting the service, which we really appreciated.

To top it all off, when we picked up our dog, they discovered fleas under his thick coat and took care of it with a flea bath without hesitation. He looks and smells amazing, and you can tell he feels so much better.

City Dog consistently goes above and beyond, and it’s clear how much they care about their business, their customers, and the pets they serve. We absolutely love our groomer and the entire team — I’m a forever customer at a place that truly sets the standard for outstanding customer service.
Awesome!
This is my dogs toys r us! She knows exactly what she wants when I take her to city dog and the staff is so great! My girl just loves going there.

Couldn’t handle my 14 year-old 7 pound dog. I even asked for someone who had the most experience with older dogs. Called me in the middle of the haircut saying that they couldn’t continue because she wasn’t tolerating it. Now she’s half groomed and looks ridiculous. After all that they still had the audacity to charge me.

Wow okay I cannot recommend this place enough! I think I've only ever written one other review in my life, but had to jump on to share my experience today, because I did not expect to have such an awesome experience. I have an 11 year old Australian Shepherd who is pretty anxious, he doesn't get groomed often because of it. I had tried another groomer a few days ago and got a text 5 minutes after I dropped him off to come back and get him, because the groomer did not have the patience to groom him. I was feeling a bit bummed and unsure if grooming was going to workout at all. So I did a search to see if there was any groomer in San Diego people really liked, that could groom anxious dogs. I found this place through a Reddit thread. My dog loved his groomer Allyson! She did such an amazing job with him, really went above and beyond. She even took him in before the shop opened, to give him a more quiet environment to be groomed. Like who thinks to do that?! That was so so thoughtful. He had both the grooming package and the teeth cleaning. I was more than happy with the result and cost of each. He looks like a puppy again! I was curious how he would be when I picked him up, some other places he just comes out acting scared. But when I picked him up today he was so happy and content. He just wanted to hang around. Which made me so happy. You can tell how much the staff cares about dogs. The location also has a great selection of merch I was checking out. I only use good quality ingredients/snacks for my dog, especially now that he's 11, and they had awesome stuff with great prices. My dog finished his visit with some healthy treats I found there. I had such an amazing experience and so did my dog. If I could give Allyson and this shop more than 5 stars I would. I genuinely can't wait to bring my dog back

I really like this place. The service is very good and they have a large variety of food and supplies. I have been here a few times to wash my dogs myself and they have everything you need from all different shampoos to blow dryers and the ear cleaning and blueberry facial is included. I also like that the tubs are against a wall so the dogs don’t really see other dogs. It’s downtown so parking is a hit or miss. As for the price I think it was reasonable especially if you upgrade the shampoo it’s not that bad.

City Dog Wash is amazing! They were so helpful and made both my dogs feel completely comfortable. Super friendly staff, and they even finished earlier than expected. Couldn’t ask for a better experience!
love this place! my dog has been so happy with her two trips to city dog~!
This place is friendly, competent, and great.

Each time we're in San Diego we take our 8lb Maltipoo to City Dog for grooming. Every visit has been a delightful experience and she comes out beautiful. This time she was exceptionally shaggy and had a matted tail. No worries, Saul took care of everything and even handled the tail issue without resorting to shaving the tail, which was recommended by another groomer. Professional, punctual and kind folks. Highly recommended. Thank you City Dog San Diego!!
My husband and I were moving to San Diego and our poor girl got sick in her carrier crate. The staff did an amazing job helping me in my time of need!
Great job giving my pup his bath. Great selection to choose from.
The staff are 100% proffecional and patient with the animals. It is clean and smells clean. The gromming service is excellent.
I love it here and so does my golden :)
Easy shopping experience and perfect place to go shopping for dogs
One stop shop for your pet need helpful staff I will definitely be taking my puppy back
They’re always great at doing my dogs nails, very friendly staff and great pricing too.

Very disappointed with this place. We used to bring our malamute about 3-4 times there. A few times service was okay, but the last time things went south.
After a visit our dog got bladder infection the next day and was peeing with blood! Not to mention that he was extremely stressed out and behaved desperate to run away at home!

Bladder infection was diagnosed by the vet and we immediately called City Dog to talk about this. The owner didn’t try to help or resolve anything, but also was super rude and dismissive!

Don’t bring your dog there. Service is terrible and dogs get infection after the visit!
The staff was very helpful. And gave us a lot of tips for bathing and drying our husky.

Disappointing experience. We've been bringing our sweet dog there for years. He's a bigger dog with a double coat that takes several hours and careful attention and the groomings usually take the better part of a day. This time he came how with an uneven completely shorn splotchy shave that seems like they basically just shaved him without any effort to actually "groom" and carefully trim him up. The experience also seems to have been traumatic for our pet who's usually cheerful and happy disposition is gone and he's been depressed for several days since. To top it off, he has a bladder infection now which we are treating. We called the groomer to discuss professionally and make things right, however, the owner of the shop was defensive and rude. I would not advise. I guess they have plenty of business and aren't interested in keeping return customers. Oh well.
This dog groomer is first class all the way.  Alicia groomed my golden doodle Opal to absolute perfection.  I would give this grooming salon 10 ⭐️’s!  Thank you Alicia and City Dog.

We’ve been coming to City Dog for many years now and the staff and service have always been great! Marisa has been patient with my dog and I’m so grateful she’s there to provide grooming services. I appreciate a local spot like this because I have ran out for dog food many times, or lost a leash. They have all of the food, toys, and accessories you could need.

Love City Dog! Gary and his super star team are amazing with my little one for the past 9 years. We have also used the self wash service in between grooming sessions. Prices are decent. Location is convenient but parking can be a challenge for those that don’t live in downtown. City Dog has accommodated us in clutch situations for last minute appointments and food selection. All of City Dog’s groomers from our experience are great and take their time and detail with grooming my baby. Alicia makes my dog feel loved and well taken care of. Will continue to support this small business. Thank you City Dog!

Had unfortunate bad experience. Had an appointment at 1pm. Was called to see if I could take her an hour early, so at noon. Sure. Took her at noon. By 3pm no call or update. They never take that long. Was told running behind. She’ll be ready at 5. I asked if she was taken for a restroom break, cashier didn’t know but would check with groomer. I was then called at about 4 ‘would you mind if we finish up on Monday?’ I went to pick her up. Was confirmed no walk to relieve her in 4 hours!!! Got home, she went directly to water bowl! Went back Monday, $130 to ‘finish’ nails never trimmed!!! And the excuse ‘we had two dogs come in AFTER her that were matted’ NEVER taking her there again. I understand it happens, but no water or potty break-UNFORGIVABLE.

I continue to have a great experience every time I bring my pups here! Ally and Alicia are grooming superstars and always take the best care of Lulu and Wrigley. We've had some unfortunate experiences with other groomers before finding City Dog, so I can 100% attest to the fact that it's not easy to find a quality, talented groomer who knows what they're doing. I'm thankful to have found them! Also, I love all the bulk treats they have available -- Wrigley thinks it's a buffet! The staff is always friendly and we love coming here. Shop local and support this gem of a business!
Everyone was very kind and they did an amazing job for my dog’s nail trim and bath. They had fun treats to pick out when I picked him up. Thank you!!
I got my socky dog all bathed up and it wasn't that bad. She hates it but it needed to be done. Now she smells like blueberries!
I have been bringing my dog here for almost 2 years for his grooming, and we live his groomer, Alicia.

I can’t think of anything negative here. They’re friendly in person and over the phone. The food selection is large and they have many healthy options for your pets. They quickly fit you in for grooming needs. Our dogs love getting their nails trimmed here. (Very affordable)
Special handling for our special doggie who does not like to be left behind. Teeth, toes, tooshie all clean and shiny. Nice people great service!

Phenomenal place! Ali was so attentive to the needs of our shih tzu puppy and did an incredible job. They are super detailed, did a shampoo, cut, checked her glands, and had great communication. Recommend this dog salon for sure :)

I love this place. Years ago I came here and used their self wash it was really handy, I recently came and it always has everything you need. The space is limited there so they carry limited food. But they have a wide range of snacks and toys!

This review is 12 years over due! Gary and his amazing staff has been incredible to my furbaby and my family.
They always give you their recommendations and know their products that they sell.
It’s truly your one stop shop for your furbaby!
I buy my Lucy her dog food, treats and grooming supplies here. I also have her nails filed (I prefer the drill the cutting them) great prices and the staff are careful with my senior dog. Jasmine usually does her nail file and she is the best!
I love their self dog wash! I generally can get in same day, they are flexible and do their best to accommodate. They are busy!!!! They are busy because they do right by their clients and their fur babies. Ask them any questions they will answer and recommend.
I like trying new treats for my dog and they will share what’s new!

They have a reward program for the dog food and self dog wash. Call them for details!

I am grateful for City Dog!

The staff is amazing, very accommodating to you and your pet. They didn't have what I was  looking for so they recommended similar products and offered to order it in for me. They are very attentive to my dog, since she is very high energy and has some special needs and if there's something my dog is comfortable with they wont push her just to get it done. I couldn't recommend this place enough!

staff not friendly !!! the groomer was not professional. they over price me at the end, because the groomer couldn't shave my dog
!! i will never take my dog again to this place !!
